## Evidence boundaries
- Maxwell Excel: 391 anonymised jobs, seven reporting periods and S$75,720 recorded revenue. These figures do not establish profit, savings or production impact.
- Cold-chain demonstration: 1,800 synthetic records, not operational history or a validated predictive model.
- VELYQUA: working manual water tests, observations and care history. Guest records stay on the current device. Fictional walkthrough readings are synthetic and educational.
- VELYQUA AI-assisted monitoring, physical sensors, early-warning performance and paying customer outcomes remain development and validation goals.
- Other industrial applications require their own customer demand and technical validation.
- ORQEVIA source, curated public demonstrations and private runtime acceptance are separate. A CI pass is not runtime acceptance.
